questions.prompt: In a DTCG token file, what makes a JSON object a token and not a group?

options.explanation: Right. The spec says an object with a $value property is a token. An object without one is a group.
$type can sit on a group too, as a default for the tokens inside it. $value is what makes a token.
Token names are your own names, like green-600. The $ marks spec properties such as $value and $type.

questions.prompt: What is the status of the DTCG Format Module 2025.10?

options.text: A W3C Standard, final and required
options.explanation: The spec says it is not a W3C Standard nor on the W3C Standards Track.
Right. 2025.10 is a Final Community Group Report, and the DTCG calls it the first stable version. It is not a W3C Standard.

options.text: An early draft not meant for tools
options.explanation: A newer draft is in progress, but that is a different document. The DTCG calls 2025.10 its first stable version.

questions.prompt: You import a DTCG file into Figma. Which token will Figma not turn into a variable?

options.text: A color token in the sRGB space
options.explanation: sRGB colours are supported by Figma's import. The unit rule applies to dimension tokens.
px is the one unit Figma's import accepts for dimension tokens. It becomes a Number variable.
Right. Figma says a dimension token's unit must be set to px. Other values are not supported.
